name: Irinotecan
route_note: IV infusion every 1–3 weeks; liposomal irinotecan (Onivyde) every 2 weeks

discovery.by: Yakult Honsha (Tokuji Kunimoto, Seigo Sawada and colleagues)
discovery.note: A water-soluble semisynthetic derivative of camptothecin, the alkaloid isolated by Wall and Wani from the Chinese tree Camptotheca acuminata in 1966.

tagline: Camptothecin prodrug of SN-38 used in FOLFIRI and FOLFIRINOX
summary: Irinotecan is a semisynthetic camptothecin prodrug converted to SN-38, which traps topoisomerase I on DNA and causes lethal DNA breaks during replication. It is a standard component of FOLFIRI and FOLFIRINOX for colorectal and pancreatic cancer; diarrhoea and neutropenia are its main toxicities.
mechanism: Carboxylesterases convert irinotecan to SN-38, which is 100–1,000 times more potent.

SN-38 binds the topoisomerase I–DNA cleavage complex and prevents re-ligation of the single-strand break. When a replication fork collides with this complex, a double-strand break forms, killing cells in S phase.
SN-38 is inactivated by UGT1A1 glucuronidation; reduced-function alleles such as UGT1A1*28 (Gilbert syndrome) increase the risk of neutropenia.
uses: Metastatic colorectal cancer (FOLFIRI, FOLFOXIRI, with biologics)
Metastatic pancreatic cancer (FOLFIRINOX; liposomal irinotecan with 5-FU, or NALIRIFOX)
Off-label: gastric, small-cell lung and other cancers

history.title: Camptothecin
history.detail: Wall and Wani isolate camptothecin from Camptotheca acuminata.

history.title: Topoisomerase I target
history.detail: Hsiang and Liu identify topoisomerase I as camptothecin's target.

history.title: FDA approval
history.detail: Approved as Camptosar for 5-FU-refractory metastatic colorectal cancer.

history.title: First-line combination
history.detail: FDA approves irinotecan with 5-FU/leucovorin as first-line therapy.

history.title: FOLFIRINOX
history.detail: Conroy et al. show FOLFIRINOX improves survival in metastatic pancreatic cancer.

history.title: Onivyde
history.detail: Liposomal irinotecan approved with 5-FU/leucovorin after gemcitabine in pancreatic cancer.

history.title: NALIRIFOX
history.detail: FDA approves liposomal irinotecan in NALIRIFOX for first-line metastatic pancreatic cancer.

pk.half_life: irinotecan about 6–12 hours; SN-38 about 10–20 hours
pk.metabolism: carboxylesterase to SN-38; UGT1A1 glucuronidation; CYP3A4

safety.boxed_warning: Boxed warning for severe diarrhoea and myelosuppression.

facts: Early diarrhoea is cholinergic (acetylcholinesterase inhibition) and is treated with atropine; late diarrhoea is managed with loperamide.
SN-38 is also the payload of the antibody–drug conjugate sacituzumab govitecan.
